extracted.name: Basic Yeast Dough
extracted.description: This dough is perfect for making donuts and cinnamon rolls. The Best part is you can put the dough in the fridge to let rise overnight! Origin: chocolatewithgrace.com
ingredient_lines: 1 cup very warm milk (115 F, I use whole milk.)
instruction_lines: In a large bowl, stir together the yeast and milk until dissolved. Beat in the sugar, butter, salt and eggs until well combined. Add the flour, one cup at a time, stirring until incorporated. The dough should be shaggy and still sticky.
Turn out the dough onto a floured surface and knead 5-6 minutes until smooth and elastic. Or if you use a mixer knead 4-5 minutes. Freeze or refrigerate at this point if desired.

If baking now, continue by placing the kneaded dough into a greased bowl. Cover and let rise for 1 hour or until doubled in size. The length of time needed to rise will depend on how warm the room is. Ideal rising temperature is 72 F.
When the dough has risen, punch dough down with a floured hand and shape and bake as desired.
